policy_levers.label: Income Tax Rate
policy_levers.description: Higher values raise direct-tax burden on salaried and high-income households.

policy_levers.label: GST Rate
policy_levers.description: Higher values lift indirect-tax burden and can transmit into consumer prices.

policy_levers.label: Policy Rate
policy_levers.description: Higher values tighten credit and curb inflation, but usually cool growth.

policy_levers.label: Capital Spending
policy_levers.description: Public capex primarily affects medium-term growth, jobs, and infrastructure capacity.

policy_levers.label: Welfare Spending
policy_levers.description: Supports lower-income households in the short run, but can pressure the fiscal position.

policy_levers.label: Subsidy Support
policy_levers.description: Broad subsidy support reduces near-term household stress but can worsen fiscal strain.

policy_levers.label: Credit Support
policy_levers.description: Directed credit support mainly benefits MSMEs, investment, and near-term demand.

policy_levers.label: Export Push
policy_levers.description: Trade and export promotion tend to improve medium-to-long-horizon growth resilience.

policy_levers.label: Infrastructure Push
policy_levers.description: Infrastructure affects jobs now and productivity later; its strongest payoff is delayed.

policy_levers.label: Debt Discipline
policy_levers.description: Stronger fiscal discipline improves long-run resilience but can reduce near-term stimulus.

macro_metrics.label: GDP Growth
macro_metrics.description: Modeled annual growth rate anchored to the latest World Bank series.

macro_metrics.label: Fiscal Stress
macro_metrics.description: Composite index from debt burden, tax capacity, and policy stance.

macro_metrics.label: Exchange Stability
macro_metrics.description: Composite index for external and currency stability.

macro_metrics.label: Trade Momentum
macro_metrics.description: Composite index for trade and export activity.

macro_metrics.label: Household Pressure
macro_metrics.description: Composite index where higher is worse for household affordability.
